column1: # Broadcom PoE control protocol (12-byte SoC <-> MCU frames). REFERENCE ONLY for the BCM59111 v21 image: the image implements the I2C register interface, not this protocol (docs/poe-fw.md section 15).
# Frame: [cmd][frame id][9 data bytes, pad 0xFF][checksum = sum of the 11 preceding bytes mod 256]; 19200 8n1 on the SoC secondary UART; big-endian multi-byte fields; ports 0-based.

# source: https://svanheule.net/switches/software/broadcom_poe_control_protocol (fetched 2026-11-19); Broadcom SDK src/soc/i2c/bcm59101.c is the I2C-side packet format reference (cite only, not copied).
